title: [AUG-11] Add keyboard accessibility to session list
why_we_need_this: Session items in SessionList.tsx are div+onClick with no tabIndex, role, or keyboard handlers. Keyboard and screen reader users cannot navigate sessions at all. WCAG 2.1 Level A failure (2.1.1 Keyboard).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] `.session-list-items` has `role="listbox"`
- [ ] Each `.session-item` has `role="option"`, `tabIndex={0}`, and `aria-selected` reflecting selection state
- [ ] `onKeyDown` handler supports: Enter (select), Delete (delete with confirmation), ArrowUp/ArrowDown (navigate between items)
- [ ] Focus is visually indicated (outline or highlight distinct from hover)
- [ ] Screen reader announces session title, status, and selection state
